header.title: Control, voice, and scope
header.description: Neryva Agent Studio shapes how an AI system behaves in customer-facing and internal settings. It keeps the agent on brand, on task, and ready to escalate when the conversation needs a human.

items.title: Brand and voice design
items.description: Define the tone, phrasing, and level of formality the agent should use so it reflects the company clearly.

items.title: Business knowledge integration
items.description: Base answers on approved company information, including FAQs, product details, policies, and support documentation.

items.title: Guardrails and escalation
items.description: Set clear limits on what the agent can answer, what it should refuse, and when it should hand off to a human.

items.title: Tool and workflow support
items.description: Connect the agent to practical business workflows such as ticket routing, request capture, form completion, and status checks.
